name: @goliapkg/kevy-ts
description: The first-party TypeScript client for kevy — the pure-Rust Redis-compatible engine. One connect(url) routes to the in-process embedded engine (mem:// / file://, over bun:ffi or the N-API addon) or a native RESP2/3 TCP server (kevy:// / redis:// / tcp://). Async-by-default with a synchronous embedded escape hatch. Runs on both Node and Bun.
